data.narrative:
Standard Bots is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company founded by Evan Beard and David Golden that has raised $200M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of nine private companies and one public entity (277810.KQ) in the robotics and manufacturing sector, with three direct stage-matched peers identified: Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for post-money valuation, applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $380M. The peer-median method anchors to three same-sector, same-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.8B and a range of $1.6B to $2.0B.

Triangulation across both methods produces a valuation range of $323M to $2.0B, with a median of $1.1B. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects uncertainty around whether Standard Bots commands peer-level valuations given differences in revenue scale, competitive positioning, or capital efficiency relative to the comparable set. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, unit economics, and the degree to which Standard Bots' technology and market opportunity justify positioning at the higher end of its peer range.
